collision_check.result: all 4 base names free; no -wt1 renames needed

judgment_calls: Recess built as inset + drop with sloped inner walls (20 tris) rather than vertical walls; reads clearly as recessed panel.
Recess floor uses MI_wax slot to read as a waxed tablet; frame and diptych remain blanks otherwise.
Diptych laid open edge-to-edge with two 6-sided leather-thong knuckles at the shared edge (not a door hinge).
Stylus in bone (MI_bone); 6-sided shaft, cone tip, flat box spatula.
Wax cake round, 10-sided tapered, dark beeswax/pitch colour; distinct from candle wax blocks, sealing-wax sticks and seal wax blanks.
BaseColor PNGs shipped in tex/ (64px tint); no image nodes in FBX.
